# Credits

<!-- Generated by tools/credits_page.py from content/credits.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every dataset, model and asset StellarForge uses, with its source and licence (checked 2026-11-15).

| Name | Kind | Licence | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| [PMData](https://datasets.simula.no/pmdata/) | dataset | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Normal days for the four crew replays; Readiness target for Forecast B. Daily values reshaped into StellarForge Readings; crew A has a planted drift. |
| [Pulse Physiology Engine (Kitware)](https://pulse.kitware.com/) | model | [Apache 2.0](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0) | Simulated chest-pain collapse and cardiac arrest (emergency replay) and simulated normal blood pressure. Estimate, not validated. |
| [NASA OSDR Environmental Data App (EDA), mission RR-1](https://visualization.osdr.nasa.gov/eda/) | dataset | [Open download, cited as visualization under the NASA OSDR terms](https://www.nasa.gov/reference/osdr-help-terms-and-conditions/) | ISS cabin temperature, humidity, CO2 and radiation dose replay (2014 rodent mission; values as labelled by NASA, not crew-measured). |
| [NASA OSDR Inspiration4, OSD-569 (complete blood count)](https://osdr.nasa.gov/bio/repo/data/studies/OSD-569) | dataset | [Processed data public, under the NASA OSDR terms](https://www.nasa.gov/reference/osdr-help-terms-and-conditions/) | Real astronaut blood values as lab Readings. |
| [NASA OSDR Inspiration4, OSD-575 (comprehensive metabolic panel)](https://osdr.nasa.gov/bio/repo/data/studies/OSD-575) | dataset | [Processed data public, under the NASA OSDR terms](https://www.nasa.gov/reference/osdr-help-terms-and-conditions/) | Checked the glucose Safety bound against real astronaut values. |
| [NASA Apollo Flight Crew Cardiovascular Evaluations (AP005)](https://nlsp.nasa.gov/search/data/details/e1fa5c55-ddfe-5548-91ba-864080319f44?dataType=EXPERIMENTS) | dataset | [Public use permitted (NASA NTRS record for NASA SP-368, distribution public)](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19760005580) | Return-to-gravity heart rate and blood pressure shift (group means from Table 6 only). Per the NASA Life Sciences Portal, privacy-protected datasets are available only by data request and the rest are public; we use no per-crew values. |
| [CGMacros](https://physionet.org/content/cgmacros/1.0.0/) | dataset | [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://physionet.org/content/cgmacros/view-license/1.0.0/). **Restriction:** Non-commercial use only, and share-alike: anything derived from it must use the same licence. Kept in its own file so the licence does not spread to the rest of StellarForge. | Simulated continuous glucose stream. |
| [UBFC-rPPG (DATASET_2, subjects 1, 3, 4, 5, 8)](https://sites.google.com/view/ybenezeth/ubfcrppg) | dataset | Research use only (shared for research purpose). **Restriction:** Research use only. Used only to measure webcam heart-rate error; the videos are not shipped and no face is shown. | Accuracy check of the webcam heart-rate estimate (mean error 4.9 bpm on 5 people; estimate, not validated). |
| [Z-Anatomy models of human anatomy](https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy) | asset | [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) | 3D body (male and female). Z-Anatomy is derived from BodyParts3D (Database Center for Life Science), CC BY 4.0: https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/lic.html |
| [Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organ Set, Body, Female (HuBMAP)](https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library) | asset | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Female organs (heart, lungs, liver, kidneys, organ outline) in the 3D body. Licence as recorded by the 3D / UI lead in frontend/public/models/LICENSE.md. |
| [StellarForge code](https://github.com/SCAPE-NASA/stellarforge) | code | [MIT](https://opensource.org/license/mit) | All StellarForge source code (see LICENSE). |
| [StellarForge 3D files](https://github.com/SCAPE-NASA/stellarforge) | asset | [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) | The body models we derived from Z-Anatomy and the Human Reference Atlas (share-alike, as their sources require). |
| [NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2026/challenges/health-monitoring-software/) | challenge | [No licence stated; the page shows Copyright 2026 NASA. NASA content guidance: generally not subject to US copyright, credit NASA as the source](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/) | The challenge we answer. Its Resources tab says participants must follow the data-use terms of each non-US-government site they use. |
| [NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026: participant FAQs](https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/resources/participant-faqs/) | challenge | [No licence stated; the page shows Copyright 2026 NASA. NASA content guidance: generally not subject to US copyright, credit NASA as the source](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/) | Submission rules: each project must describe how SI (AI) tools were used. |
| [NASA Human Research Program: risks and hazards](https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/risks/) | challenge | [NASA content guidance: generally not subject to US copyright, credit NASA as the source](https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/) | The 17 HRP risk titles on the measurement cards and the HRP risk map; the five hazards. |

- PMData: Thambawita V. et al., PMData: A Sports Logging Dataset, MMSys '20, doi:10.1145/3339825.3394926
- NASA Apollo Flight Crew Cardiovascular Evaluations (AP005): Hoffler GW, Johnson RL. Apollo flight crew cardiovascular evaluations. In: Johnson RS, Dietlein LF, Berry CA, eds. Biomedical Results of Apollo. NASA SP-368, 1975:227-264. Experiment AP005, doi:10.83263/e60z-1h46
